image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers at a desk reviewing a large desktop monitor positioned on the RIGHT. Screen shows a blank form with two unlettered rectangular fields and ONE large unmistakable white checkmark in a separate small outlined success tile near the screen upper-right. One person points to the success tile without touching it; another considers with open palm. The full checkmark is large and unobstructed; no words or digits.

image_review.summary: 通过：纯黑背景白色火柴人线稿，单幅双人工作沟通场景、底图无文字；屏幕上独立清晰的对勾符号可框选；成功反馈由对白定义。 其余3词仅以明确对白支持，不虚构局部框。 局部裁剪复查后扩大右/下边界，保护完整道具。
